places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Over a hard winter July proposes, baby Martin survives a fever, Dish arrives with word of Gus's death, and Lorena sinks into silent grief.
places.location_hint: Allen horse ranch on the North Platte in Nebraska; Dish reached it by following the Platte through a blizzard

places.name: North Platte River
places.note: Dish follows it through a January blizzard to reach Clara's place.

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Clara's fanciful caps are ill-suited to its bitter winter.

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: July wishes Dish had gotten lost there on his way down.

places.name: Texas
places.note: July wishes Dish had gone on there; Dish thinks of returning there by spring if Lorena stays cold.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Clara tells Lorena that going along would only have left her stuck there among indifferent men.

places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Lorena's silence toward Dish is like the one she kept there, only deeper.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the Rio Grande

groups.label: Clara's household
groups.hint: through the winter into spring; Dish stays on to help with the colts
